_: The site's looks: how a page sits on the screen, on every page. One entry per look; the phone looks each have src/looks/<id>.css, loaded on demand by src/look-boot.js and swapped by src/looks.js. Add a look = a file + an entry; replace one = swap its file, keep its id. shape picks the picker card's miniature: page | sheet | device | dock (the card is painted in the theme in force). padAlwaysOut: the range's on-screen pad is part of the body, never folded. The touch-screen default is data-look-touch on <html> in each page. A look shapes; a theme (src/themes/) paints.
